correctness.rationale: The actual frozen RESULT.md lines 13–17, and the repaired result, have no prefactor n. A prefactor in an abbreviated rendering is not in the source: the two-point identity already has exactly two square roots, whereas adding n would predict four. Since g²=f implies gf=fg, g preserves S=im f=Fix f, acts there by an involution π, and sends a whole fiber to the fiber indexed by π. Within a fixed fiber, choosing the j nondistinguished points already sent to its root leaves a free map of the other points to those j; in a transposed pair, choosing the two directly-to-root sets leaves a free map of each remaining set to the chosen set in the opposite fiber. The choices are recoverable from g and suffice to give g²=f. This gives exactly F and V, including empty sets by 0⁰=1, and independent cycle choices multiply. If g⁴=g², every vertex reaches Fix(g²) in at most two steps, so the cycle lengths divide two and all attached trees have height at most two; the converse follows on every vertex. The image of g² is exactly the set of cyclic vertices. The tree series is z exp(z exp z); a component of cycle length d=1,2 contributes (uR)^d/d, giving the companion series. Neither formula or its parameters changed in the repair. Exhaustive independent enumeration agrees on all idempotents through n=7, including 9 roots for the unequal profile (2,3). The rank coefficients can also be checked by choosing r cyclic labels, an involution on them, j first-level vertices, their root choices, and the attachment of the remaining vertices. This gives binom(n,r) I_r ∑_j binom(n−r,j) r^j j^(n−r−j) and reproduces the formal n=8 total 3280524.
residual_risks: The n=8 result is from the coefficient formula, not exhaustive enumeration. The argument addresses finite total transformations and idempotent targets, not arbitrary non-idempotent targets or extremal root counts.

A statement about the aggregate count after summing over all target maps cannot by itself resolve the individual square-root fiber, where the distinct enumeration here lies.

evidence: For bounded-height functional components the factor T_k^d/d has d cyclic labels; replacing it by u^d T_k^d/d gives the global rank EGF because all cyclic labels and only those labels are in im g². For a fixed idempotent, the prescribed g² requires parity-dependent attachments to specific labeled fibers of prescribed sizes. The total cycle/tree formula forgets those targets, and endpoint cases or order-constrained formulas do not give the independent matching weights for arbitrary fiber profiles.

originality.rationale: This PASS is for the repaired distinct claim only. The frozen original's novelty discussion bundled the global rank EGF into the novel statement. That part is not accepted as a distinct novelty: OEIS A060908 explicitly gives the same unmarked class and the general bounded-height cycle-factor enumeration; inserting u per cyclic vertex recovers this rank series by direct marking. The repaired RESULT.md credits that exact prior coverage and retains the marked EGF as a standard companion, not a novelty claim. The all-idempotent, fixed-target matching sum, particularly the explicit paired-fiber interaction V(a,b), is the surviving distinct contribution. Known identity and constant cases remain credited.
residual_risks: Kozyra 2021 could have further relevant specialization; no full text was checked. Goulden–Jackson is credited via A060908; no claim is made about the unseen book's fixed-target enumeration.
The earlier chain entry 12bb479c61e2 was available in the index summary only, not the exact mirror path. Priority of the full arbitrary-target profile sum is not certified.

value.rationale: The repaired main claim is a natural complete preimage count for the squaring map over every idempotent of the full finite transformation monoid. The two-cycle interaction between unequal kernel classes adds exact information not obtainable from the classical constant and identity counts or from the unmarked aggregate. The formula reduces the calculation to weighted matchings on the rank-many fibers, with explicitly computable local factors. This provides a reusable exact count across every idempotent profile. The globally marked EGF is useful context, not evidence of original value for the repair.
residual_risks: The output does not address roots of non-idempotents, arbitrary semigroup restrictions or maximizer problems; no algorithmic complexity or asymptotic theorem is claimed.
